name: turrent-bot
description: An advanced, high-performance Telegram Bot built with Python (`pyTelegramBotAPI`) and `aria2c` that allows users to send Torrent magnet links or `.torrent` files, interactively choose which files to download using Telegram inline buttons, and upload them directly to [Buzzheavier](https://buzzheavier.com) with **zero permanent storage footprint** on the RDP server.
